all.name: All
all.description: Bluff your way to the last die!

roleInfo.name: Player
roleInfo.description: Roll your dice and bluff your way to victory!

saveValueInCache.name: tutorialText1
saveValueInCache.value:
Each player secretly rolls dice (shown in your hand as cards). Take turns bidding the total dice showing a given face among ALL players combined. Each bid must be higher than the last — either more dice, or same count with higher face.
Example: '3x4' means at least 3 dice showing 4 across all players.

saveValueInCache.name: tutorialText2
saveValueInCache.value: Instead of bidding, call BLUFF on the previous bid! All dice are revealed. If the bid was accurate (total matching dice >= bid qty), the caller loses a die. Otherwise the bidder loses a die. Lose all your dice and you're eliminated. Last player standing wins!
